title: XIRR validates optional scalar guess before vectors, rejects logical guess as #VALUE!, and returns #N/A for singletons
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, XIRR(values, dates, [guess]) reads optional scalar guess before inspecting values and dates (rejecting logical guess with #VALUE! and guess <= -1 with #NUM! after scalar coercion of values and dates), returns #N/A when both values and dates have length 1 even at a negative date, rejects 2-D ranges or arrays with #REF!, and requires dates >= dates[0] alongside both positive and negative cashflows.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in prefix_metadata (row 394) and xirr_checks_singleton_shape_after_guess_and_scalar_coercion controls, and matched across 2,861/2,861 full-bank XIRR rows.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA

evidence.note: Guess precedence, logical rejection, and singleton #N/A check
